_comment: IMPORT-ONLY patch for the D17 launch-to-state harness (tasks/mods.md D17). Adds the mh.dll import to a stock mh.exe with NO code patches, so DllMain runs and MH_Launch_Init arms the auto-driver when a launch verb (--load <name>, etc.) is on the command line. Deliberately vanilla: no pool relocation, so the sim runs exactly as retail. Run: python mhpatch.py apply mh.exe launch_load.mh.patch.json mh.launch.exe   (then drop mh.dll beside mh.launch.exe and start with:  mh.launch.exe --load <name>). The save name has no extension and resolves to save\<name>.sav.
